Dialogs.Dialog: It's raining. But it may be nice to have a different atmosphere from the usual, ▲主人公＊▲.
Isn't it romantic to date on a snowy day, ▲主人公＊▲？
Hehe, boys also have big umbrellas, ▲主人公＊▲.
Yes, I came a little early. It's snowing, so I got excited.
Sorry to keep you waiting. It's coming down, huh.
Yes. I hope it doesn't get heavy...
It's fine. I was watching the snow. See, it's beautiful.
It's wet, so be careful. Being late AND getting hurt？ Don't, okay？
Sorry. Making you wait this long, in the snow...
(Ah, wait, today's our date！ Don't tell me...)
Geez, I waited and waited... You're super late, you know？
(Ah, wait, today's our date！ Don't tell me...)
Thank goodness, you're home. You were late, so I came to get you... Did something happen？
(Ah, wait, today's our date！ Don't tell me...)
I couldn't wait, so I came. That's okay, right？
(Did I get here a little early？ I'll wander around...)
(Oops, I was at the convenience store and more time passed than I thought.)
Sorry！ I got here early, but I wandered off and it took longer...
...That still counts as late, right？ Geez.
(Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. She hasn't noticed me yet.)
Ow, ow... That one was my fault...
(Huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲ isn't here yet... Maybe I'll call her.)
Hello？ Huh？ I just called you, didn't I？
I called you too... We called at the same time.
We're totally in sync... Ah, there you are.
Sorry to keep you waiting. I'm glad I found you.
Don't make that face, I won't get in the way. Later！
Ah, he's here... Um, so, my date's here now, so！
Sorry to keep you waiting. Were you just getting hit on？
Was I？ ...I really don't like people like that. Please don't keep me waiting, okay？
There you are. Sorry I'm late.
Sorry, she looked like you from behind...
Sorry！ I made you wait so long！
No, actually I was late too. I just got here...
That's rare. I was sure I'd have to apologize.
Me too. But I'm glad I didn't make you wait.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ isn't here？ Where is she？)
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Were you about to do something？
I wanted to do "Guess who！" I almost had you.
Crap, I'm so late... I need to get changed！
I came to get you. Did you forget our plans？
Sorry, I was doing a bunch of things and lost track of time...
You're in too much of a hurry... Um, your shirt's inside out.
Whoa！ Sorry, I'll change right away！
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What are you doing crouched down there？
There was a dog？ I didn't notice.
Yes, it was cute♪ It ran off because you yelled.
(Um... huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is talking with a foreigner.)
He asked me for directions... He's from Germany.
No, in English. German conversation is a bit beyond me...
(She's not here...？ That's rare, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ being late.)
I just got here too. Did something happen？
Mama took my umbrella... I chased after her and ended up late. I'm sorry.
(Is she particular about her own umbrella？)
Huh？ Is something weird about me？
Your hair's sticking up. Bedhead？ Or is it the humidity from the rain？
Yes... um, does my butt look weird？
Your butt？ No, it looks fine.
Thank goodness... I slipped on the snow and fell earlier... Ah, I'm not hurt, so I'm fine.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ slipping in the snow... Sorry, but I kind of wish I'd seen it.)
▲主人公＊▲. Look, look, I made it while I was waiting.
Whoa, an elaborate snowman... A work of art.
I tried hard♪ I'll take a picture.
(She doesn't seem to mind that I was late... I'll keep quiet.)
The wind blew your hair... it's all messed up, you know？ Here, crouch down.
(Embarrassing... but lucky, if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is fixing it.)
I didn't see, I didn't see！
What's wrong？ ...Is it hard to say？
It's fine. I didn't think you'd agonize that much...
I tried wearing the present you gave me. Does it suit me？
Did you notice I'm wearing this？ It's my favorite.
I tried wearing this present... I'd like to hear what you think？
I'm glad. If it makes you happy, I want to wear it all the time... Just kidding.
I'm glad. I'll keep treasuring it.
So you don't care... Even though it's something you gave me...
...Maybe it's not how you imagined？ Sorry...
I'd like to see a new style
Why not try a new length？
You'd like something different？ ...Hmm, then I'll think about it.
You didn't like this？ I see...
Really？ Okay, but... if anything comes up, tell me？
You look like you want to say something？ ...You can be blunt.
Eh... but I just changed it. Hmm...
That's... how should I take that？
My hair's gotten long, right？ I was thinking it's about time to cut it.
Maybe I was hoping you'd say that.
Right... Yes, maybe I'll do that.
My new hairstyle... What do you think, do you like it？
My hair color... I changed it. Do I look different？
Eh... is this no good？ I was a little confident...
That kind of reaction puts me on the spot...
Hey, what are you doing for lunch？
What are you doing for dinner today？
It's already this late. I'm getting hungry...
I'm fine for now, I think...
Ah, looks like it's clearing up...
Clouds are coming in. Will it rain？
Ah, snow！ Hey, how much do you think it'll snow？
Looks like it started raining outside？
Yes, I like it. Let's go？
Geez... don't ask things like that.
No, while holding the umbrella... right？
We'll get wet from the rain... okay？
No. It doesn't have to be at a time like this, does it？
No... I don't want you to do that.
I don't think I'd be happy... with that.
We're off-balance, it's hard to walk...
Here？ Okay, but... I don't look weird, right？
A photo？ Since we're at it, make me look cute... Just kidding.
Please don't... I don't think I can smile right now.
It's still early, but I'm starving. Want to eat something together？
I'm getting hungry. Want to have lunch？
It's about dinnertime. What do you want to do？
Actually, I'm hungry too... Let's go？
I'm... fine for now, I think.
You brought your umbrella... Too bad.
...That umbrella isn't... broken, by any chance？
Ah, you have an umbrella. I missed my chance to share one. Just kidding.
Did you forget your umbrella？ Then... here, come under.
If you don't have an umbrella, then together...
Didn't bring an umbrella？ Then... let's share one▼
No umbrella？ Then let's both use this one.
I'm glad I forgot it... Just kidding.
Forgot your umbrella？ Then let's both fit under mine.
Thank you. I didn't forget it on purpose, you know？
Rain, huh, and I didn't bring an umbrella...
Sorry, you're not in the mood？
Hey... nobody's looking right now, you know？
Um... since we're at it, I'd like this better.
I like this better. Is that okay？
Hey... are we in the right place today？
...Sorry, looks like I got it wrong.
Oh, so that's it. ...Hey, since we're here, why don't we have our date here？
(If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is fine with it, then okay...)
Huh... Hey, is this the right way？
...Ah, did I take a wrong turn？
I see... We'll run out of time, so how about here？
(If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is fine with it, then okay...)
Hey, hey, what are we playing？
So many to choose from. Which one are we playing？
Hmm, I'm in the mood for...
Any of them is fine with me...
...I'd like to play a little more, I think.
That looks fun. Go for it！
All right, I'll live up to your expectations！
All right, I'll do my best.
When things go badly, nothing goes right, huh...
I got up early today and made a bento. Let's eat here？
Um, I brought a bento. Will you eat it？
Today's lunch is a wife-made bento♪ Just kidding.
Then, want to come to my place？
Your place？ ...Yes. I think I'd like to see it.
...There, there. Want to play？ Sorry, but I'm on a date right now.
What a clingy doggy. Thank you for worrying about me.
Oh, it just wanted to play.
Ah, that little kid... all alone. Lost, maybe？
Good thing his mom was nearby. It's thanks to you noticing right away, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
It was just luck. Besides, you're the one who found her.
Huh, my phone... Hey, could you call it once？
Ah... sorry, I just put it in a different pocket than usual.
Yes, sorry. It was Papa. He didn't seem to want anything in particular...
That's dangerous, even though this side is for pedestrians.
Yes. But you protect me, so I'm fine.
I wonder what that person stopping people is doing？
I'm not good with those. If they come over, I'll want to run off.
Aren't you going to read it？
I can read texts later. Right now, you're what matters.
You always come first for me, you know？ ...Just kidding.
It looked like Charpoix, the tennis player... She's gone. I wanted to meet her, I'm a fan！
Excuse me. Could you take our picture？
They were a cute couple. But... we're just as good, right？
Hm？ Oh, what's this, the two of you together.
...Ah, I see, you two. Well, take care.
Geez, why are you so nervous？
Hey, want to grab something to eat？
It's dinnertime... Want to eat out？
I figured you'd say that, so I made a bento.
Ooh, yes！ Let's eat, let's eat！
Is it okay to extend our date a little longer？
Do you have plans after this？ I'd love to be with you longer.
Do you still have time, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ I'd like you to stay with me a little longer...
Yes. I want to be with you longer too.
Great. Then where should we go？
Time... but just a little should be okay.
Okay. Then I need to decide where to go, fast.
I want to... but I have plans after this. Sorry.
Then it can't be helped. Next time...
I'm happy you asked, but it's already time...
I've already had... plenty, I think.
I'll invite you to my place.
Um. Can I borrow your shoulder？
A little... I want to lean on you... Is that okay？
I'd like to be even closer？
I'm happy... I wouldn't mind staying like this forever.
Maybe you can hear my heartbeat...
Next to you... is my favorite place.
We're here already？ I wish we could stay like this forever.
Haha, what to do... For now, let's get off.
Ah... did you see my sleeping face... Geez, forget it？
Then... I'll take you up on it.
I feel like the spot next to you was made just for me...
Hey, what if we couldn't separate like this anymore？
Hey, want to stay together a bit longer？ My room, if that's okay.
Yes. I want to be with you too.
It's getting late... they'll worry about me.
I want to be with you a little longer... Can I come to your room？
Really？ Then I'll come in, okay？
I see... Asking all of a sudden puts you on the spot.
Sorry. My place isn't ready for guests.
Ah, right, I have a present for you.
I still want to be together...
Manaka！ If you're home, come inside right now.
Hey, since we're here, want to stop by my house？
If you like, want to come in？ Papa and Mama aren't home, so I can't treat you properly, though.
"Have a safe trip."... Just kidding. Bye-bye.
Thank you for today too. Get home safe.
Be careful on your way home. Bye...
While we were fighting... How were you？
Not being able to really talk with you was hard, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Me too. So I was happy today. ...I hope it's like "after the rain, the ground hardens."
Yeah, that's it. From now on, let's get along even better.
Um... you're really not still mad about the other day？
Yeah. If I were mad, we couldn't go on a date.
Thank you too, for making up with me.
Thank you for today. I'm really glad we made up.
Yeah. If we were still fighting, we couldn't go on dates like this.
Of course. I don't want to fight anymore.
